description: Profile-2 FOUR-CORNER bundle (CF-5, twenty-first review): the federated Evidence Package plus the B.1 RelayAcceptance object its rdp_chain[] hop references. This is the bundle in which the per-hop reference is actually BOUND — bundle_lint LINT-BND-20 recomputes seal_digest (SHA-256 over the DECODED COSE_Sign1 bytes of the B.1's seal, TS clause 4.1) and rejects a mismatch. evidence_lint sees one object at a time, so its LINT-EP-06 can only confirm the hex is well-formed; ANY 64-hex string survives there. Recipient-side entity (EU-FR-PSBID) as in bundle.default. Paths are relative to this manifest's directory.
